mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.head, r.introduce, r.student_id, r.release_date_time, file.original_name AS file_name, file.object_name, file.file_url AS file_url, cover.file_url AS cover_url, s.name AS student_name, avatar.file_url AS avatar FROM resources r LEFT JOIN student_file cover ON cover.id = r.student_file_cover_id LEFT JOIN student_file file ON file.id = r.student_file_file_id LEFT JOIN it_student s ON s.student_id = r.student_id AND s.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN student_file avatar ON avatar.id = s.avatar_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM resources WHERE resources.student_id=#{studentId}
